meta.excluded_note: Withdrawn and desk-rejected papers are excluded from all statistics.
meta.corpus_note: NeurIPS publishes accepted papers plus a small opted-in minority of rejections (~5%). Counts measure what was ACCEPTED, not what was submitted. Acceptance rates and withdrawal rates cannot be computed. NeurIPS also changed its rating scale between 2024 (1-10) and 2025 (1-6); scores are not comparable across those years.

caveats.Label quality: Measured on 55 NeurIPS papers whose titles name a concept unambiguously: 96% of those concepts were recovered, and 9% of predicted labels had no matching phrase in the paper text. Treat per-concept counts as accurate to a few percent, not exact.
caveats.Not shown: Acceptance rates and withdrawal rates: rejected and withdrawn submissions are not public at NeurIPS, so there is no denominator to compute them from.
caveats.Comparing with the ICLR page: These labels were made under the 84-concept taxonomy; the ICLR page's were made under an earlier 73-concept one. Each page is internally consistent, but concept shares are not strictly comparable between the two.
